{{Quote|Incidentally, that Crisp-E-O unit I started with still works the breakfast shift. Now that I've found success, I suppose I could replace it with a fancy modern droid, but being fancy isn't what we do here at Dex's Diner.|Dexter Jettster|<ref name="Dining at Dex's">{{Hyperspace|url=fans/hyperspace/source/dexdiner/index.html|text=Dining at Dex's|int=Dining at Dex's}}</ref>}}
The [[Chef/Legends|chef]] [[Dexter Jettster/Legends|Dexter Jettster]] owned a '''Crisp-E-O donut droid''' on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. It worked for him first at [[Dex's Donuts]] and later at [[Dex's Diner/Legends|Dex's Diner]]. Its internal database included over 2,400 [[Doughnut/Legends|donut]] recipes.
